preservedResponsibilities: Task200 connects numeric ODFF source to real ScTokenArray/shared FormulaCompiler RPN, ScInterpreter and existing ScFormulaResult inside the actual document-sheet-column formula blocks. Native scalar arithmetic precedence, code/runtime error projection, lazy result state, default bracket completion, forced recalc and logical formula-block events are represented. ScSheetLimits, RTL parsing/cancellation, mdds and shared token/result owners are reused. Formula pointers use JS GC; no physical pointer deletion or reference counting is introduced. Source constructor/service subsets are explicit. References/functions, localized formatter/string conversion, groups/listening/recalc dependencies, serialization/ODS/UI, complete contexts/RNG/caches/vector/hash scheduling and broad parity remain unsupported. Native power fenv-only subnormal classifications reject explicitly. Formula block copy/clone is noncopyable and unavailable semantic equality throws instead of substituting identity. Broad parity/verification flags remain false.

Task201 implements valid same-sheet ODFF A1 references through actual ScSingleRefData/ScSingleRefToken/RPN, borrowed document/formula cell views and numeric/empty/direct-text results. Actual shared Svt observers, typed broadcaster stores and native logical FormulaTrack/FormulaTree queues propagate edits and remove subscriptions on replacement/clear. Default dirty context is -1/-1/false; normal noniterative cycles return522; forced/manual modes and inserted-sheet positions are represented. Broad native constructor/service parity remains unverified. JS GC owns physical lifetime; Dispose closes semantic subscriptions/queues only. Cross-sheet/external/range/named references, functions, locale string-to-number conversion, area/group/iteration/deep-recursion services, full context/formatting, formula serialization, ODS and UI remain unsupported. These are bounded implementation slices, not broad native parity.

Task203 implements native ScHorizontalCellIterator row-major traversal over actual shared mdds const block cursors,with original column-parameter vector,SkipInvalidInRow/FindNextNonEmptyRow order,stable borrowed result owner,inclusive area bounds and original allocated-column clamp. Native GetCellStore/ClampToAllocatedColumns and toRefCell provide the same real typed values used by editing. No cell grid,snapshot,priority heap or alternate document model is created;formula cells are not evaluated by iteration.
omittedResponsibilities: References, functions, localized formatter/string formulas, dependency/listener services, ODS/UI, complete constructor/service APIs and broad parity remain unsupported.

Only existing sheets,valid typed-store area coordinates and numeric/string/formula/empty block families are supported. SetTab retains the constructor column clamp and requires that allocated-column domain on the next sheet;out-of-domain input rejects explicitly rather than creating columns. Rich edit text,all other dociter families,full document services,ODS filters and UI remain unported. JS GC owns physical lifetime;native borrowed-result and iterator invalidation preconditions remain caller responsibilities. Broad native contract/behavior/default parity is not certified.
